{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The pressure drop at P-R (below alarm threshold) triggered the AL-44 alarm, which RHOB reported as an 'air-low' indication and used to request Utilities attendance.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "claim-x9yg85"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If P-R pressure had remained above 5.0 bar, AL-44 would not have triggered and RHOB likely would not have requested attendance at that time.",
      "competingExplanation": "RHOB could have detected the issue via other means (e.g., process upset) without relying solely on AL-44; however, evidence links 'air-low' to P-R drop.",
      "evidenceGap": "Exact timestamp of RHOB's initial report vs. alarm trigger is approximate ('About 10:00') but consistent with pressure drop timing."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-ax2alr",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The low-pressure event at P-R created a hazard scenario during boundary preparation, potentially due to an unrecorded service-routing change or undocumented valve state (hypothesis).",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If no unrecorded change or undocumented valve state existed, the hazard scenario would not have been unique; however, evidence does not confirm either condition.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could be a routine supply disturbance (e.g., upstream maintenance) rather than an 'unrecorded' change. Evidence explicitly states records do not establish whether it began at source, distribution, or receiving equipment.",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence confirms the existence of an unrecorded service-routing change or undocumented valve state; absence of a record does not prove its occurrence."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-q7dwrs",
      "toKey": "n-1ubp9xd",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The blank work package field execution record and pending maintenance acceptance signature indicate incomplete boundary preparation, which may have contributed to the crew's vulnerability when the air supply was interrupted.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the work package had been fully executed and accepted before 10:00 AM, the crew might have had clearer procedures or authority to respond differently.",
      "competingExplanation": "The blank record alone does not prove it caused the event; other factors (e.g., upstream supply failure) could be primary causes. However, incomplete documentation is a contributing condition.","evidenceGap":"No direct evidence links the blank work package field directly to the air interruption or alarm trigger."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-3ykejq",
      "toKey": "n-se46ow",
      "type": "enabled",
      "rationale": "The daily briefing lacked valve-by-valve content, which may have left the crew unaware of potential service-routing changes or undocumented valve states affecting RHOB.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, the crew might have been better prepared for supply disturbances.",
      "competingExplanation": "The absence of detailed briefing content does not prove it caused the event; other factors (e.g., upstream failure) could be primary causes. However, insufficient information is a contributing condition.","evidenceGap":"No evidence confirms whether recent changes were briefed or if crews used outdated drawings."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event was an instrument-air low-pressure indication at RHOB (P-R) triggering alarm AL-44 and pausing work. Supported conditions include the pressure drop, alarm thresholds, blank work package field execution record, and pending maintenance acceptance signature. Unknown or unsupported hypotheses involve unrecorded service-routing changes or undocumented valve states; evidence explicitly states records do not establish these conditions. Contributing factors may include incomplete boundary preparation (blank work package) and insufficient briefing content.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Exact cause of pressure drop (source vs. distribution vs. receiving equipment)", "Existence of unrecorded service-routing change or undocumented valve state", "Whether crews saw recent changes or used different drawings"],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream supply failure unrelated to RHOB boundary preparation", "Routine maintenance activity upstream causing temporary interruption"],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },"evidenceRequests":[
    "claim-1ado6d5","finding-1hfd1r1"
  ]}
